newsitem.title: CANADA: Rogers appoints new Cablesystems CEO.
newsitem.headline: Rogers appoints new Cablesystems CEO.

text.p: Rogers Communications Inc said on Wednesday it appointed Jos Wintermans as chief executive and president of unit Rogers Cablesystems, Canada's largest cable network operator.

Wintermans' appointment takes effect June 2, Rogers said in a statement. He will oversee Rogers' cable television operations in Ontario and British Columbia, 175 Rogers Video stores, Internet access service, and the home security unit.
Before joining Rogers, Wintermans was Canadian Tire Corp's senior vice-president of diversified businesses such as the credit card arm and gas stations.
